title: App Studio 改版（follow-up of 3-2）：设置里旧的元数据目录别名按 setup.access 决定去设置还是留在 Studio
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbL6Nn3scsU8yvLyU4

Filing gate: ③ · Source: seat 5's delta review 7199669663 on PR #37602 (#37565), finding S3, option (b). PR #37602 took option (a), a text fix. Sub-issue of #37565.
Grade: area:ux · Feature · p3 · evidence: `setupMetadataRedirect.ts` sends Setup's old `/apps/*/metadata` catalog aliases to the Setup directory page unconditionally. Studio's `~all` addresses already check `setup.access` after #37565.
Reader: area `ux-37424`, or the next holder of area:ux.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：没有「设置」权限的人，打开旧的设置元数据链接时，会留在 Studio 的目录，不会落到一个打不开的设置页。
- 为什么：#37565 已让 Studio 里的旧地址按权限分流，设置那一侧的旧别名还没有。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

- Give the hosts of `setupMetadataRedirect.ts` (the AppContent alias routes) a fail-closed `setup.access` read, so that no answer counts as no access. Reuse `holdsSetupAccess` from #37565. Do not use `usePermissions().hasCapabilities`, which fails open.
- Without `setup.access`, the alias lands on the Studio environment-scope list, as `~all` does after #37565.

## Acceptance

- Both branches are tested, along with the no-answer case. An ablation goes red. The full redirect chain is asserted.
- Wait until PR #37602 merges.
